CheckTitle: Ensure IAM AWS-Managed policies that allow full '*:*' administrative privileges are not attached
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices/Identity and Access Management
Description: Checks whether AWS-managed policies granting full administrative privileges (Action * on Resource *) are attached to any principal.
Risk: Full administrator policies violate least privilege; any compromise of an attached identity becomes a full account compromise.

Recommendation.Text: Detach AdministratorAccess-style AWS managed policies and grant only the permissions each principal needs.
